issues.description: Method Stock.getStockIngredients() has different return types across artifacts: the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) declares public List<StockIngredient> getStockIngredients() while the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) declares public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients(). The problem statement instructs students to "add getters for all the private fields," which implies exposing the actual private field type (StockIngredient[]). This mismatch is likely to confuse students about which return type to implement and will cause tests or autograding to fail if they expect the array type but the template's getter returns a List.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getter signature consistent. Recommended: change the template method signature to public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients() (and return the internal array) so it matches the private field type and the solution. Alternatively, if you prefer exposing a List, update the problem statement and solution to explicitly require and document a List<StockIngredient> getter and adjust tests accordingly.
